slices.focus: Nadia builds a three-metric spreadsheet dashboard to prove the tighter intake process reduces downstream fires.
slices.summary: Nadia creates a plain three-metric spreadsheet dashboard tracking first-housing days, pending benefits tasks, and 90-day check-in completion. The goal is to show leadership that the stricter housing packet and intake changes are reducing follow-up failures, not just creating paperwork. She plans a short walkthrough with leadership using a one-page handout focused on three measures (housing speed, benefits progress, 90-day follow-up), framing it as cross-team visibility rather than personal defense.
open_loops: Prepare one-page handout with three measures
Lead walkthrough with leadership — open with problem, three measures, concrete signs of improvement
Eat and hydrate before the meeting to maintain focus
Frame as operational evidence, not personal vindication
decisions: Nadia shifted from just enforcing the revised inspection packet to tracking first-housing days, pending benefits, and 90
